column1: # Malformed / hostile WebSocket messages (QA-owned). Spec: docs/protocol.md sections 4, 5, 11, 12.
# Columns: id, layer, state, expect, frame, note.
# layer:  DECODE    ProtocolJson.decodeFromString<ClientMessage>(frame) must throw; the server answers error malformed_message
#                   and keeps the connection open.                           (core test: ProtocolDecodingQaTest)
#         TOLERATED either malformed_message, or processed exactly like the canonical message (expect = canonical answer).
#         SERVER    decodes; the server must answer error <expect> (alternatives separated by '|'), keep the connection open,
#                   and change no state (a following resync shows the same room version / queue state).
#         SIZE      size limits: expect is an error code, 'pong' (processed), or close:<code>.
# state:  ANY (fresh connection, no seat) | QUEUED | LOBBY_HOST (private room host, alone, teamSize 2) |
#         CHOOSING (quick 3-digit duel, nobody chose) | GUESSING (quick 3-digit duel, round 1, nobody guessed yet).
# expect 'ok' = the server must accept the message (ack when rid is set).
# Binary frames, fragmented messages and frames over 16 KB are produced by test code (MalformedFrameQaTest), not listed here.
# Format: UTF-8, tab-separated, '#' starts a comment line, first non-comment line is the header.
# Escapes in text columns (decoded by the QA loaders, QaCorpus.kt):
#   \R[N:TEXT] repeats TEXT N times (inside TEXT write \] for ']').
# Invisible, control, bidi and confusable characters are ALWAYS written as escapes so a reviewer can see them;
# QaCorporaWellFormedTest fails if a raw invisible/control/bidi character appears in this file.

column6: unknown type (server side; clients ignore unknown types)
unquoted key (lenient JSON must be off)
duplicate type: any consistent interpretation, never a crash
unquoted number for a String field: rejected, or read as the guess "123"
lone surrogate via JSON escape: must never be broadcast
raw control character inside a JSON string (invalid JSON)
deeply nested unknown value under the 2048-byte cap: no stack overflow
error for duel messages without a seat is unspecified (DEF-034)
very long code under the byte cap
full-width letters must not match a real code unless NFKC is applied consistently
emoji only, sent as a JSON surrogate pair
Arabic-Indic digits (Char.isDigit() is true for them)
675 x 3 bytes + 24 = 2049 bytes: the cap is bytes, not characters
700 escaped ZWSP = 4200 bytes on the wire
